C0660.title: Man Sentenced After 600 Fraudulent Complaints in One Year to Extort Couriers
C0660.summary: Starting in late 2022, a man surnamed Wang purchased low-value items online, deliberately provided vague addresses, and refused to answer calls. After couriers were forced to leave parcels at collection points marked as 'signed', he filed complaints with postal authorities alleging forged signatures and demanded hundreds of yuan in compensation.
